rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose way to mean the amount swallowed in one gulp.

example.english: I finished this cup of tea in one gulp.
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 caa4 ngo5 jat1 daam6 zau6 jam2 saai3

rows.note: Use this for the audible swallowing sound, especially when someone is nervous or afraid.

example.english: When they heard there was a ghost, they couldn't help making a gulp sound.
example.traditional: 佢一聽到有鬼，就忍唔住發出吞口水聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 teng1 dou3 jau5 gwai2 zau6 jan2 m4 zyu6 faat3 ceot1 tan1 hau2 seoi2 sing1
